notSetUpMessage: Google Meet integration isn't set up for this institute. Connect a Google Workspace account under Settings → Live Session → Google Meet Integration, or paste a meeting link in the Live Class Link field below.
linkCreatedOnAccount: A Google Meet link is created on this account.
anyoneWithLinkJoins: Anyone with the link joins (no knocking) — best for learners.
guestsMustKnock: Guests must knock and the host admits each one.
settingsApplyToNewLinks: The settings below apply to Meet links created now; links that already exist keep their settings.

field.joinAsViewer: Learners join as viewers (no mic or camera)

planHint: Recording, transcript and notes start when the organizer or a teacher on the institute's Google Workspace joins, and are saved to the organizer's Drive. Recording and transcripts need a Workspace plan with recording (Business Standard or higher, Education Plus); Gemini notes need a Gemini licence. If the plan lacks a feature, the class is still created without it.
hostControlsWarning: Only the organizer account ({{email}}) is a host. A teacher who joins with any other Google account is treated as a participant, so keep screen sharing open if teachers present from their own accounts.
